name: Mapbits
description: Oracle Application Express (APEX) plugins to enhance Map region functionality. Plugins include support for various functions such as drawing and recording features, zooming to extents, displaying legends with symbology, interactively switching basemaps, and exporting maps as images. Other plugins support custom layer types, such as WMS, REST, and Oracle Georaster. Best of all, Mapbits feature the Lodestar plugins which tap into the full functionality of maplibre to allow greater customization.
